cohort: 177 patients receiving inpatient treatment and undergoing surgery (obstetric or gynaecologic) in a tertiary referral centre.
finding: Out of 177 patients, only five (2.8%) who underwent caesarean sections tested positive for COVID-19, and no COVID-19 transmission to staff was recorded.
mod_finding: Out of 140 patients who underwent caesarean sections, only five (2.8%) tested positive for COVID-19.
